plan.notes: Official 4-year plan of study published in the Sam Houston State University 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog (catalog.shsu.edu). Courses, credits, and semester placement transcribed verbatim from the catalog plan grid; catalog footnotes preserved as choice notes. Credit ranges resolved to the minimum (catalog totals are ranges).
